page.overview:
What is Adventure Phantom Mangle?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Phantom Mangle's appearance is almost identical to their core series counterpart, but it is smaller. Like most of the Phantoms, its eyes are white dots surrounded by a single white ring. The same goes for the endoskeleton head. It looks identical to Adventure Mangle in design, similar to its core series counterpart, albeit with a charred and ghostly look to it.

Phantom Mangle is more powerful than Adventure Mangle, and a good character to use throughout most of the game. Its best attack is Pizza Wheel 2, as it deals large damage over groups of enemies. Toxic Bite can damage a few enemies as well as inflicting poison on them, being a relatively good attack. Mystery Box swaps the player's party members for random party members, even ones that the player has not obtained yet. While this can be good in a pinch, it is a luck-based attack, and is risky to use, as it can often give the player an unbalanced or below-average party.
